status: project-design schematic coordinates, not real-world navigation instructions

axes.unit: schematic art unit; region contract uses 4 units/cell; not claimed source metres

transform_formula: world = origin + R(yaw) * [4*x,4*y]; yaw180 rotates without mirroring. D01 uses current berth vessel pose and separate inset scale.

near.state: steadily-on all night; not blinking signals
near.structure: one lighthouse with front and rear views, never duplicate two near lights

far.state: off until c18 then steady; low stone lantern room
far.height_note: Design light heights relative to water reference, not tower staircase count. Raise plinth modestly if needed; cargo access remains short ramp, no high stair carry.

navigation_alignment.meaning: On designated inner-harbor approach, near lower light and farther higher light align. Vessels turn within inner basin before near-light land. This is not a route into the far-light island or outer sea.
navigation_alignment.sideview_rule: A side/off-axis final shot shows two separate beacons at distinct positions. Do not shift their world coordinates merely to make two glows visible.

blocked_loading_branch.morning_state: harbor tug clears before empty-ferry pickup

features: no heavy-box loading zone at rear berth
personnel_path.mode: staff walk only; no resource/map reset

tidal_creek.note: M04 and M05 have navigable water connection only; no visible boardwalk across creek

outer_sea.visible_sign: render via reliable UI/post-typesetting; do not ask image model for readable writing

holding_area.state_until_c18: safe small craft held behind rope
holding_area.state_after_c18: first internal ferry released after both steady lights checked

occlusion_constraints: No high warehouse on M03→near-light sightline
No high warehouse on E45→near-light sightline
Near/far light sightline must remain open along y40
Near personnel path cannot be painted as cargo road
Island gap remains water in all backgrounds

source_vs_design.source_facts: Topology, route restrictions, identity, tasks, cargo path and beacon purpose from v1.1
source_vs_design.provisional_design: All numeric coordinates, light heights, camera placement, material palette and shoreline contour

supersedes: world-schematic.json version1.0; world layout is unchanged
vessel_transform_formula: Right-handed boat [X starboard,Y up,Z stern] -> berth=[5+X,5.5+Z] -> schematic [east,south]=origin+R(yaw)*(scale*berth) -> right-handed 3D [east,scale*Y,south]. Determinant +scale^3. Never reflect either axis.
vessel_pose_rule: Use current boat.dock. D01 inherits that exact pose and changes camera only. M04 yaw=180, determinant positive (rotation), never mirror.
